quote: “Light, my light, the world-filling light, the eye-kissing light, heart-sweetening light!”
source: Rabindranath Tagore, Gitanjali (Song Offerings), poem 57, first line (trans. the author, 1912)

evidence.where: Project Gutenberg plain text of Gitanjali (Song Offerings), the 1912 English prose versions by Tagore with Yeats’s introduction (eBook 7164), section 57
evidence.edition: Gitanjali (Song Offerings), Macmillan, 1912, the author’s own English

reason: Section 57 of the 1912 English Gitanjali opens with exactly this sentence, exclamation mark included. Tagore made the English versions himself, so no third-party translator is named.
